stem.text: A student investigated the hydrolysis of lipid in high-fat milk, using the enzyme lipase.

items: $1\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of enzyme solution was added to $10\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of high-fat milk.
The pH of the reaction mixture was recorded at time 0 minutes and every minute for 20 minutes.

stem.text: Which statements correctly describe the expected results of this investigation?

items: The product forms more slowly as time proceeds because the concentration of the substrate is decreasing.
The pH of the reaction mixture increases rapidly in the first few minutes and then increases less rapidly.
The increase in the concentration of product eventually causes the lipase molecules to denature.
